text.translation: Woman: Hey, let's stop going there.{n}Something about that place bothers me.

text.reference: 男：いいや正体を暴いてやる。{n}奴の、おでこのバンソーコーを、{n}ひっぺがしてみたいんだよ。
text.translation: Man: No, I'm going to expose him.{n}I want to rip that bandage right off{n}his forehead.

text.reference: 女：ばかみたい。{n}なんの意味があるのよ。
text.translation: Woman: That's idiotic.{n}What would that accomplish?

text.reference: 男：別に………{n}ただ、そうしたいだけ。
text.translation: Man: Nothing...{n}I just want to do it.

text.reference: 男：やっぱり、あの店のオヤジ、{n}やばい奴だ。客を見てると、かたぎとは{n}思えない連中ばかりだからな。
text.translation: Man: I knew that shopkeeper was trouble.{n}Look at his customers--not one of them{n}looks like an honest citizen.

text.reference: 女：ねぇ、やめましょうよ。{n}もうこれ以上かかわらない方がいいわ。
text.translation: Woman: Come on, let's drop this.{n}We shouldn't get any more involved.

text.reference: 男：そうだな、やめよう。
text.translation: Man: Yeah. Let's drop it.
